mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=su.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE su.id=#{userId} AND su.status='active' AND p.permission_key='${permission}' AND ((ur.scope_type='asset' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(${assetExpr} AS CHAR)) OR (r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')))

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=su.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE su.id=#{userId} AND su.status='active' AND p.permission_key='${permission}' AND ((ur.scope_type='data_source' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(${sourceExpr} AS CHAR)) OR (r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')))

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=su.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE su.id=#{userId} AND su.status='active' AND p.permission_key='${permission}' AND ur.scope_type='model_registry' AND ur.scope_id=${modelExpr})

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=su.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE su.id=#{userId} AND su.status='active' AND p.permission_key=#{permission} AND ((ur.scope_type='asset' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(${assetExpr} AS CHAR)) OR (r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')))
mapper.select: SELECT sa.id,sa.agent_key,sa.asset_id,a.asset_key,sa.platform,sa.agent_version,sa.status, sa.last_heartbeat_at,h.window_end,h.flows_seen,h.flows_emitted,h.flows_dropped,h.queue_depth_max, (SELECT sc.config_version FROM sensor_config sc WHERE sc.sensor_id=sa.id AND sc.status='active' ORDER BY sc.activated_at DESC LIMIT 1) config_version, (SELECT sc.flow_window_seconds FROM sensor_config sc WHERE sc.sensor_id=sa.id AND sc.status='active' ORDER BY sc.activated_at DESC LIMIT 1) flow_window_seconds FROM sensor_agent sa JOIN asset a ON a.id=sa.asset_id LEFT JOIN sensor_health_window h ON h.id=(SELECT h2.id FROM sensor_health_window h2 WHERE h2.sensor_id=sa.id ORDER BY h2.window_end DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE ORDER BY sa.id LIMIT 200

SELECT aa.id,aa.asset_id,aa.authorization_ref,aa.status,aa.valid_from,aa.valid_until, rq.username requested_by,ap.username approved_by,aa.created_at FROM asset_authorization aa LEFT JOIN sys_user rq ON rq.id=aa.requested_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ap ON ap.id=aa.approved_by WHERE aa.asset_id=#{assetId} AND
ORDER BY aa.valid_until DESC,aa.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT ds.id data_source_id,COUNT(ib.id) batches,COALESCE(SUM(ib.accepted_count),0) accepted, COALESCE(SUM(ib.rejected_count),0) rejected,MAX(ib.created_at) last_batch_at, (SELECT sm.mapping_version FROM source_mapping sm WHERE sm.data_source_id=ds.id ORDER BY sm.id DESC LIMIT 1) mapping_version, (SELECT sm.status FROM source_mapping sm WHERE sm.data_source_id=ds.id ORDER BY sm.id DESC LIMIT 1) mapping_status FROM data_source ds LEFT JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.data_source_id=ds.id WHERE GROUP BY ds.id ORDER BY ds.id LIMIT 200

SELECT id,policy_key,version,environment,action_type,CAST(action_params_json AS CHAR) params, auto_execute,approval_required,max_duration_seconds,status,approved_by IS NOT NULL approved FROM response_policy ORDER BY policy_key,id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT at.id,at.event_id,e.event_key,req.asset_id,a.asset_key, CAST(at.action_request_json AS CHAR) snapshot,at.status,rq.username requester,rv.username reviewer, at.decision_reason,at.expires_at,at.created_at,at.reviewed_at, (SELECT x.status FROM action_execution x WHERE x.approval_task_id=at.id ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) exec_status FROM approval_task at JOIN JSON_TABLE(at.action_request_json, '$' COLUMNS(asset_id BIGINT PATH '$.assetId')) req ON TRUE JOIN asset a ON a.id=req.asset_id JOIN security_event e ON e.id=at.event_id JOIN sys_user rq ON rq.id=at.requested_by LEFT JOIN sys_user rv ON rv.id=at.reviewed_by WHERE at.requested_by=#{userId} AND
ORDER BY at.created_at DESC,at.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT mr.id,mr.release_status,mr.review_status,rq.username requester,ap.username approver, mr.request_reason,mr.decision_reason,mr.reviewed_at,mr.created_at FROM model_release_record mr JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=mr.model_version_id LEFT JOIN sys_user rq ON rq.id=mr.requested_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ap ON ap.id=mr.approved_by WHERE mv.id=#{modelId} AND
ORDER BY mr.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT md.id,md.environment,md.mode,md.model_version_id,mv.model_key,mv.version,md.runtime_type, md.status,md.activated_at FROM model_deployment md JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=md.model_version_id WHERE ORDER BY md.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT dw.id,dw.data_source_id,mv.model_key,mv.version,dw.window_start,dw.window_end, CAST(dw.feature_stats_json AS CHAR) features,CAST(dw.score_stats_json AS CHAR) scores, dw.quality_reject_rate,dw.drift_status FROM drift_metric_window dw JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=dw.model_version_id WHERE ORDER BY dw.window_end DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT fs.id,fs.alert_id,da.alert_key,fs.label,fs.label_source,rv.username reviewer, fs.reviewed_at,fs.dataset_version,fs.training_eligible FROM feedback_sample fs LEFT JOIN detection_alert da ON da.id=fs.alert_id LEFT JOIN sys_user rv ON rv.id=fs.reviewed_by ORDER BY fs.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT tj.id,tj.job_key,tj.dataset_version,tj.sample_manifest_ref,tj.train_host_ref,tj.status, rq.username requester,tj.started_at,tj.finished_at,tj.result_manifest_ref,tj.failure_reason FROM model_training_job tj LEFT JOIN sys_user rq ON rq.id=tj.requested_by ORDER BY tj.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT rs.id,rs.scenario_key,rs.name,rs.dataset_ref,rs.environment,rs.safety_profile,rs.status, lr.run_key,lr.status run_status,lr.speed,lr.progress,lr.started_at,lr.finished_at, CAST(lr.summary_json AS CHAR) summary FROM replay_scenario rs LEFT JOIN replay_run lr ON lr.id=(SELECT r2.id FROM replay_run r2 WHERE r2.scenario_id=rs.id ORDER BY r2.id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY rs.id LIMIT 200
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND p.permission_key='alert.read' AND (r.role_key<>'platform_admin' OR (ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')))
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(da.detected_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00') h,COUNT(*) c FROM detection_alert da JOIN ingest_record ir ON ir.id=da.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=ir.batch_id WHERE da.detected_at>=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND ir.asset_id IS NOT NULL AND AND AND GROUP BY h ORDER BY h

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quality_status='accepted'),0) a, COALESCE(SUM(quality_status='manual_review'),0) m, COALESCE(SUM(quality_status='rejected'),0) r FROM ingest_record ir WHERE ir.created_at>=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND ir.asset_id IS NOT NULL AND
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{userId}
